result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a stuck loading indicator on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner and an inconsistent/missing background for its favorite button.

issues.description: White circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner image under 'Popular right now', making the card look broken or not fully loaded.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the banner image finishes loading and dismisses the spinner; use a proper skeleton/placeholder while loading and add error fallback/retry if the image fails to load.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner lacks the dark circular background used on the pizza card below, making it faint and visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark semi-transparent circular button background to all favorite icons for consistent visibility and contrast.
